Title: Life in Turkey
Content: . . .Under the rule of President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, things have improved. My friend’s cousin showed off his new Mercedes-Benz, bragging about the state aid his family received and his general well-being. “I live like an American here!” he said. So of course he would vote again for Mr. Erdogan, who has been in power for the best part of `text(two decades)`. The imprisonment of government critics? Not for him to worry about. . . .
